$description: Votepit design system 2026 — the single token source. Layers: primitive (literal values only) -> semantic (roles; aliases to primitive or semantic) -> component (aliases to semantic or component; literal sizes allowed, literal colours not). Format: W3C design-tokens style ($type/$value, {path} aliases). Generate with `node core/packages/ui/tokens/build-tokens.mjs`; never edit generated files. Spec: VotePit-Designkonzept v1.0 §7; deviations in core/packages/ui/DESIGN.md.

porcelain-deep.$description: Sunken areas, skeletons (not in concept §7; derived).

sage.$description: Calm decorative plane; secondary text on forest.

mint.$description: Accent words on forest only (derived; large text).

brick.$description: Down votes and brand graphics (brick, not accent).

accent.$description: Accent CTA: top-bar sign-up, primary conversion CTA per view, featured plan, marketing headline marker. Never on or next to vote controls.

up.$description: Original logo top facet — preserved, logo only.

down.$description: Original logo bottom facet and 'pit' — preserved, logo only.

strong.$description: Planned status (owner decision 2026-10-22: own colour so Planned never reads like Open). 6.86:1 on white, 5.93:1 on plum.soft.

halo.$description: Second ring colour for two-tone focus on changing grounds.

forest.$description: Hosting seal ring and glyph (landing content, not a UI role).

emerald-ink.$description: Hosting seal proof link, 7:1+ on porcelain.

black.$description: German flag stripe; content exception, used only by the DE hosting seal.

red.$description: German flag stripe; content exception, used only by the DE hosting seal.

gold.$description: German flag stripe; content exception, used only by the DE hosting seal.

control.$description: Dark theme: control border (3:1 on card).

paper.$description: Dark theme: primary text and primary button fill.

ink-deep.$description: Dark theme: text on light fills.

pos-solid.$description: Dark theme: up-vote solid fill (ink text on it).

neg-solid.$description: Dark theme: down-vote solid fill (ink text on it).

warn-text.$description: Dark theme: progress and warning text.

warn-tint.$description: Dark theme: progress and warning soft background.

focus.$description: Dark theme: focus ring (3:1 on canvas and card).

stagger.$description: Delay step between list items arriving one after another.

celebration.$description: Documented exception to the 240 ms max: the referral-reward confetti rain only (Celebration.tsx). Never under reduced motion.

celebration-sparkle.$description: Documented exception to the 240 ms max: the board-milestone sparkle only (Celebration.tsx). Never under reduced motion.

wide.$description: Wide desktop: status rail next to the list (G-12).

size.$description: 40 px mobile, ~62 px at 1440, 76 px at ultrawide.

gutter.$description: Page side margin: 16 px mobile, ~32 px at 1440, 64 px at ultrawide (no narrow centred strip).

celebration.$description: Celebration overlay exception (confetti rain). Above the 240 ms motion max by design; only the Celebration confetti animation may use it.

celebration-sparkle.$description: Celebration overlay exception (sparkle pop). Above the 240 ms motion max by design; only the Celebration sparkle animation may use it.

workspace-max.$description: Board workspace (app). The website has no global max width (brief 2).

field-width.$description: Settings: normal single-line fields (Tailwind max-w-ds-field = max-w-sm).

field-width-long.$description: Settings: long text such as textareas and URLs (Tailwind max-w-ds-field-long = max-w-lg).

tint-sage.$description: Varied initials tints for idea authors (social feed); ink text on each tint.

selected-ring-up.$description: Outer ring of a selected For button: tone-matched to its fill, never the shared green selection colour.

selected-ring-down.$description: Outer ring of a selected Against button: tone-matched to its fill.

field-up-background.$description: Large tinted For field (card and detail only).

field-down-background.$description: Large tinted Against field. Down colour is brick/negative, never coral.

status-edge-width.$description: Coloured left edge that carries the idea status (owner decision 2026-10-22, V1).

status-edge-planned.$description: Planned: own plum tone, distinct from Open (info blue).

status-edge-closed.$description: Declined and archived: neutral, never an error colour.
